brief.preparing.meaning: Shows in the brief while Cadence prepares today's brief.

brief.unavailable.meaning: Says today's brief could not be shown, when no more specific reason is known.

brief.did-not-finish.meaning: Says today's brief stopped loading before it arrived, with Try again.
brief.did-not-finish.text: Today’s Daily Brief did not finish loading.

brief.request-limit.meaning: Says the brief hit its request limit and when to try again.

brief.timeout.meaning: Says the brief took too long to load and tracking still works.

brief.offline.meaning: Says the brief could not load because the device appears to be offline.

brief.sign-in-again.meaning: Says the session ended and the person must sign in again to load the brief.

brief.context-changed.meaning: Says the Timeline or settings changed while the brief was prepared, with Get a current brief.

brief.retry-exhausted.meaning: Says today's retries are used up and tracking still works.

brief.turned-off.meaning: Says the brief is turned off or not offered, and points to Settings.
brief.turned-off.text: Daily Brief is turned off or unavailable. Check Settings.

brief.could-not-prepare.meaning: Says Cadence could not prepare today's brief, when the server names no recovery.

brief.chatgpt-usage-limit.meaning: Mac: says the ChatGPT plan's usage limit stopped today's brief, with Manage usage.
brief.chatgpt-usage-limit.text: ChatGPT usage limit reached. Review your plan or Cadence’s limit in ChatGPT settings.

brief.chatgpt-not-eligible.meaning: Mac: says the person's ChatGPT plan cannot run the brief and how to use Cadence instead.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line (Emi, product map answer 1).

brief.chatgpt-reconnect.meaning: Mac: says ChatGPT must be reconnected to load the brief on the person's plan.
brief.chatgpt-reconnect.text: Reconnect ChatGPT to load today’s Daily Brief on your plan.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line (Emi, product map answer 1).

brief.chatgpt-retry-later.meaning: Mac: says ChatGPT could not run today's brief this time, with Try again.
brief.chatgpt-retry-later.text: ChatGPT could not run today’s Daily Brief. Try again later.

previous.change: Error style: one Rust Signal line (Emi, product map answer 1).

brief.plan-off.meaning: Mac: says under the brief that ChatGPT plan usage is off, so this brief did not use the plan.
brief.plan-off.text: ChatGPT plan usage is off, so this brief did not use your plan.

brief.refresh.not-ready.meaning: Says Refresh asked for a new brief that is not ready yet; the current brief stays.
brief.refresh.not-ready.text: The new brief isn’t ready yet. Try again shortly.
brief.refresh.not-ready.label: Not refreshed

brief.refresh.limit-reached.meaning: Says today's refreshes are used up; the current brief and its lines still work.
brief.refresh.limit-reached.text: You’ve used today’s refreshes. This brief stays, and every line still works.
brief.refresh.limit-reached.label: Not refreshed

brief.refresh.budget.meaning: Says Refresh is paused to keep the month's morning briefs; the current brief still works.
brief.refresh.budget.text: Refresh is paused to keep this month’s morning briefs. This brief stays, and every line still works.
brief.refresh.budget.label: Not refreshed

brief.refresh.offline.meaning: Says Refresh could not run offline; the current brief stays.
brief.refresh.offline.text: You appear to be offline. This brief stays; try again when you’re connected.
brief.refresh.offline.label: Not refreshed

brief.refresh.rate-limited.meaning: Says Refresh was asked too often and to wait a minute.
brief.refresh.rate-limited.text: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
brief.refresh.rate-limited.label: Not refreshed

brief.refresh.failed.meaning: Says Refresh failed for a reason Cadence cannot name; the current brief stays.
brief.refresh.failed.text: Cadence couldn’t refresh the brief. This one stays; try again later.
brief.refresh.failed.label: Not refreshed

brief.calendar-stale.meaning: Server: says in the brief that the calendar did not load, so no new times that depend on it are offered.
brief.calendar-stale.text: Your calendar did not load, so no new times that depend on it are offered.
brief.calendar-stale.label: Calendar not current

brief.budget-reached.meaning: Server: says the month's advisor budget is used, so this is Cadence's short brief, and when the full one returns.
brief.budget-reached.text: Daily Brief reached this month's limit, so this is Cadence's short version.{lines, select, yes { The suggested moves, Yes and Undo still work.} other {}}{until, select, none {} other { The full brief returns {until}.}}

brief.words-unavailable.meaning: Server: says the written part of the brief did not arrive, so this is Cadence's short version.
brief.words-unavailable.text: The written part of today's brief did not come through, so this is Cadence's short version.{lines, select, yes { The suggested moves still work.} other {}}
